trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰہُمَّ عَذِّبِ الْفَجَرَۃَ الَّذِیْنَ شَآقُّوْا رَسُوْلَکَ وَحَارَبُوْا اَوْلِیَآئَکَ وَعَبَدُوْا غَیْرَکَ وَاسْتَحَلُّوْا مَحَارِمَکَ وَالْعَنِ الْقَادَۃَ وَالْاَتْبَاعَ وَمَنْ کَانَ مِنْہُمْ فَحَبَّ وَاَوْضَعَ مِنْہُمْ اَوْرَضِیَ بِفِعْلِہِمْ لَعْنًا کَثِیْرًا۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA A’ZZE-BIL FAJARA-TAL LAZEE-NA SHA-AQ-QOO RASOOLA-KA WA HAARA-BOO AWLIYAA-A-KA WA A’BADOO GHAIRA-KA WAS-TA-HALOO MAHAARE-MAKA WAL A’NIL QAADA-TA WAL ATBAA-A’ WA MIN KAANA MIN-HUM FA-HABBA WA AWSA-A’ MIN-HUM AW-RAZE-YA BE-FE’LE-HIM LA’NAN KASEE-RAN.

trans.en: O Allah, send your punishment upon the sinners and destroyers, the ones who envied Your Prophet and fought against Your friends, and worshipped other than You, and reckoned the acts forbidden by You as Halal. (O Allah) curse their leaders and followers, and all those accompanied them and were deceived, then were disgraced along with them, or were content with their behaviour, curse them immensely.
trans.rurdu: Ay Allah! Un faajiro’n ko azaab mein mubtela kar jinho’n ne Tere Rasool ki mukhaalefat ki aur Tere waliyo’n se jang ki aur (Tujhe chhod kar) Tere gair ki parastish ki, aur Teri haraam ki huwi cheezo’n ko halaal samjha. Ay Allah (baatil) rehbaro’n aur (unki) pairwi karne waalo’n ko aur jo bhi unke giroh mein se ho, jinho’n ne un se dagha-baazi ki, unke dushman ka saath diya ho, ya unke fel (amal) par raazi ho un par ziyadah se ziyadah laanat kar.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰہُمَّ عَجِّلْ فَرَجَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِکَ عَلَیْہِ وَعَلَیْھِمْ وَاسْتَنْقِذْھُمْ مِنْ اَیْدِی الْمُنَافِقِیْنَ الْمُضِلِّیْنَ وَالْکَفَرَۃَ الْجَاحِدِیْنَ وَافْتَحْ لَھُمْ فَتْحًا یَسِیْرًا وَّاَتِخْ لَھُمْ رُوْحًا وَّفَرَجًا قَرِیْبًا وَّاجْعَلْ لَّھُمْ مِنْ لَّدُنْکَ عَلٰی عَدُوِّکَ وَعَدُوِّ ھِمْ سُلْطَانًا نَّصِیْرًا۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA A’JJIL FARAJA AALE MOHAMMADIW WA WAJ-A’L SALAWAATE-KA A’LAIHE WA A’LAI-HIM WAS-TANQIZ-HUM MIN AIY-DIL MONAAFE-QEENAL MOZIL-LEENA WAL KAFARA-TAL JAAHE-DEENA WAFTAH LAHUM FAT-HAN YASEE-RAN WA A-TIKH LAHUM ROOHAN WA FARA-JAN QAREE-BAN WAJ-A’L LAHUM MIN LA-DUNKA A’LAA A’DOOWE-HIM SULTAA-NAN NASEE-RAN.

trans.en: O Allah, hasten in the relief of Mohammad s Progeny (peace be upon them), and send Your peace upon him and them, and deliver them from the hands of the misguided hypocrites, and from the evil of the infidels and the deniers. And destine them with an easy relief, and bless them with a nearing relief and relaxation, and bestow upon them from You through them a powerful dominance and governance over Your enemies and their foes.
trans.rurdu: Ay Allah! Aale Muhammad (a.s) ki khushi ke din jald la aur Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par rehmat naazil farma aur unhe in gumrah karne waale munafiqo’n, munkir, kaafiro’n ke panje (zulm) se najaat de aur unki aasaan fatah ke darwaaze khol de aur unke liye raahat o insaaf aur khush haali ke din qareeb kar aur apni bargah se apne aur unke dushmano par ek aisa ghalba ataa farma jo unka behtareen madad-gaar ho.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
